SELECT id, title, description, status,is_rated, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM questionnaire WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO questionnaire (title, description, status,is_rated) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{status},#{isRated})
